thread:
maria: Heads-up — oncall handoff for tenant 'Northbridge' is 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Need a quick config ownership checklist and call out any air-gap blockers.

ajay: I can own networking/firwall rules. Which subnets are we finalizing?

maria: Final subnets: 10.20.0.0/22 for compute, 10.20.4.0/24 for infra. Need confirmation on NAT egress path and proxy allowlist.

elena: Image-sync creds still pending from customer security. Until we get the signed S3 manifest, airgap bootstrap will fail. Pinged their Sec at 11:30 PT — no reply yet.

ajay: Noted. For NAT egress: fallback path is the peered transit in us-west-2; primary is local NAT gateway. Please add a rule to allow 35.112.0.0/12 to reach registry endpoints.

maria: @ajay can you add firewall ticket and assign to infra? Also, who will own cert rotation during handoff?

ajay: I'll open the FW ticket. Cert rotation — @sam volunteered last sprint for cert ops for this tenant.

sam: Confirmed, I can do cert rotation. I'll add a small script to the runbook: `./rotate-certs.sh --tenant northbridge --dry-run` and test on staging tonight.

maria: Perfect. Two quick checks: 1) Is `agent-v2` image pushed to the airgap bundle? 2) Are the kubelet flags for `--pod-max-pids` set per the tenant profile?

elena: Image: agent-v2 not in bundle — it's blocked by the missing manifest. kubelet flags: yes, `--pod-max-pids=200` is set in the node config.

ops-bot: runbook: https://rwd-internal/runbooks/private-deploys/northbridge — added last-edit @maria

sam: I'll queue the PR for `rotate-certs.sh` and leave a CR comment for @ajay to review the FW rules in the infra repo.

ajay: ack. I'll review the PR tonight. Also need to coordinate with netops during the 08:00 UTC window; can someone add that to the calendar invite?

maria: Added netops and the customer's oncall to the invite. Please note the cutover window is 08:00–09:30 UTC, with an expected 10–15 minute restart for control-plane services.

elena: Quick QA note — the bootstrap health-check sometimes flaps if image digest mismatches. I can add a defensive check to abort the bootstrap with a clear error if digest != manifest. Saves us debugging during handoff.

sam: Good call. I'll include that check in PR. snippet: ```if [ "$IMAGE_DIGEST" != "$MANIFEST_DIGEST" ]; then echo "digest mismatch"; exit 1; fi```

maria: Ownership summary so far: networking/fw -> ajay; cert rotation/runbook -> sam; image manifest chase -> elena; oncall primary -> maria. If anyone wants to swap, say now.

ajay: fine with that. I'll create ticket ENGINFRA-6123 for the firewall opens and link it in the runbook.

elena: I'll follow up with customer Sec and escalate if no response by 17:00 PT.

ops-bot: action: ENGINFRA-6123 created by ajay — https://tracker/ENGINFRA-6123

maria: Final ask: please post short status in this thread after you finish your item (so handoff doc is up-to-date). If any showstopper pops up, call the channel and we'll postpone. :thumbsup:

sam: Will update here after CI runs and PR merges.

ajay: FW ticket created and attached to runbook. Leaving a note to netops about the transit fallback.

elena: Escalation sent to customer Sec. If they don't respond by EOD I'll open the temporary mirror path and notify ops for manual vetting.

maria: Thanks everyone — nice and tidy. I'll post the final handoff summary 07:30 UTC tomorrow.

(reacts: maria :white_check_mark:, ajay :rocket:, sam :eyes:)
